answer_1.quote: We evaluate answers from seven state-of-the-art LLMs using automatic metrics for surface quality, relevance and factuality...
answer_1.outputs: long-form answers to culturally specific questions

answer_2.quote: We thus adopt a multi-aspect evaluation protocol including (1) surface-level measures of language identification and repetition; (2) automatic factuality and relevance metrics...

answer_3.quote: we employ LLM-as-a-Judge using GPT-4O. That is, we prompt GPT-4O to decide whether each answer is relevant to its question...

answer_4.quote: We recruit native speakers via Prolific and Upwork... Annotators are presented with a question, reference answer (if available), and answers generated by the three models...
answer_4.guideline: annotators are asked to: (1) identify whether it is in the correct language, (2) mark minor and major errors, (3) evaluate factuality, (4) note significant omissions, (5) comment on the answer's overall quality, and (6) rate it on a 5-point scale
